company.name: Mercedes-Benz Research & Development North America, Inc.

positions.title: Autonomous Vehicle Trainer and Senior Vehicle Test Operator
Vehicle Test Operator
positions.description:
The role of a vehicle test operator mainly focuses on understanding the system of a self driving car, it's components and capabilities. Through testing in dynamic real world scenarios, feedback is provided to fine tune the system.

•	Familiarize with self-driving vehicle sensors and capabilities and troubleshooting.
•	Monitor software systems via laptop and provide concise written and verbal feedback to the engineering team.
•	Conduct specialized system testing and capabilities of self-driving vehicle. 
•	Flexibility to assist in a dynamic environment with change prioritization of assignments.

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
The role of a Research Engineer at Biomedical Forensics consists of unique blend of critical thinking, data acquisition, analysis, and engineering fundamentals to manage several projects and deadlines while utilizing engineering concepts in accident reconstruction and biomechanics. 

•Utilize problem solving skills to determine most probable explanations of various complex scenarios.
•Familiarize with biosensors in order to create protocol, explain functionality, gather and analyze data. 
•Extract, compile, and present most useful information to implement in project calculations and analysis.
•Research diverse engineering principals and their application in project basis and presentations.

positions.title: Integration Specialist
positions.description:
As an Integration Specialist at View Inc., I was able to work with cross-functional teams of the Field Service Engineers, Sales, and the rest of the Site Operations in order to insure assist in the installation and integration of the View Inc. control systems and firmware. I also assisted in quality control, and construction of the sale samples to assist the sales team.
 
•Managed and created sell sample requests by tracking, soldering, programming, assuring quality, and maintaining communication with cross functional teams. 
•Assisted in the creation of configuration files and configuring network controllers for new project sites based on schematics.
•Utilized critical thinking to assist field service engineering team and site operations to insure fluid site functions and integration.
•Integrated software updates on system controls.

positions.title: Student Assistant Coordinator
positions.description:
As a Student Assistant Coordinator I had the privilege of working very closely with the New Student Orientation Coordinator in developing, not only the training program for the orientation team, but also the brand new Orientation Program for the incoming first year students.

•	Designed and coordinated a comprehensive training program for 16 paraprofessionals in preparation for the position of orientation leaders.
•	Overseeing the preparation for orientation of over 2,000 incoming students.
•	Led the learning and implementation of the relationship building activities.
•	Co-Created and facilitate resource workshops for incoming students to be engaged and effective.

positions.title: Student Orientation Leader
positions.description:
As a Student Orientation Leader, I had the privilege in assisting incoming students transition into the University by representing the University of California, Merced with my knowledge, experience, enthusiasm and a positive attitude. I gained experience in:

• Leading groups of 8-12 new students in team building activities, ice breakers, and discussions
• Answering parent's questions about the school or the lifestyle in Merced, CA.
• Advising groups of 50+ engineering students on course registration and scheduling
• Practicing public speaking by having the lead role of the introduction and welcoming skit.
• Co-leading with the Orientation Leader Recruitment by scheduling promotional tabling events, employing social media (i.e. Facebook) for advertisement, and presenting to on-campus clubs/organizations

positions.title: Student Peer Instructor
positions.description:
As a Student Peer Instructor I assisted in activities and discussions for the students in the Introduction to Undergraduate Studies 10 course in the University of California Merced. Students learned skills such as time management and discussed topics like Victim and Creator Mindset. As a Student Peer Instructor I:

•Prepared weekly lesson plan activities.
•Created bonds with students to build support in academic success.
•Engaged in discussions about course material.

projects.title: Capstone Design: Diagnostics Tool
projects.description:
This Project consisted of a new, low powered, easy to use, low cost diagnostics devise. The devise is much more portable and uses less powered and was designed to be used in the field. I worked with a team of different engineers in this project and some of the responsibilities were as follows:	
•	Created a new form of point of care device to diagnosed diseases. 
•	Implemented existing technology such as Maglev, lasers, and 3-D printing to create a sensor. 
•	Develop a new way of multi detection using low powered laser based array.
•	Rapid prototyping  and concept testing.
